inputs_and_states:
Liquid in one or two syringes; syringe type, inside diameter and volume; infusion/withdrawal rate; target volume. Legato 210 (788210) supports infuse only, withdraw only, infuse/withdraw, withdraw/infuse and continuous modes, and stores one program. Target time is available in infusion-only or withdrawal-only mode. Supply: 100–240 VAC, 50–60 Hz. USB/RS-232 ASCII commands control run/stop and infusion/withdrawal settings. Family 15-pin I/O: direction input rising edge = infuse, falling edge = refill; footswitch can toggle run/stop or start/stop on configured edges; trigger input is TTL high/low. Listed input thresholds: HIGH ≥2 V, LOW ≤0.4 V. Multi-program/advanced 210P features and the 0–10 V analog-input option listed only for 788212/788272 are not assigned to the standard 210. Installed controller/firmware applicability must be checked.
Source: Manuals/KDS Legato 200 Series_5617-002REV2.0.pdf, PDF pp. 6, 8, 11, 17–19, 62–65, 79, 89. Model scope: Legato 210 (788210).
outputs_and_states:
Infused or withdrawn liquid, according to the selected Legato 210 mode; infused/withdrawn volume, elapsed time and current-rate responses. Serial STATUS reports rate, time, volume, infusion/withdrawal direction with idle/running state, limit switch, stall, trigger state and target reached. Family TTL outputs: direction HIGH = refill, LOW = infuse; sync rising edge = start infuse, falling edge = start refill; run output active LOW = running. Trigger outputs 1/2 can be set HIGH/LOW by serial command and default LOW. Listed output levels: HIGH ≥3.8 V, LOW ≤0.4 V, source/sink current ≤6 mA. Event-program behavior remains configuration-specific. Simultaneous push/pull capability of the 270 and advanced multi-program features of the 210P are not assumed.
Source: Manuals/KDS Legato 200 Series_5617-002REV2.0.pdf, PDF pp. 6, 8, 11, 17–19, 62–65, 79, 89. Model scope: Legato 210 (788210).
units_of_measure:
Flow-rate command units: pL, nL, µL or mL per second, minute or hour (syringe-dependent limits). Syringe/target and infused/withdrawn volume: µL or mL; syringe diameter: mm. Time: s and h:m:s. Raw serial STATUS: fL/s (rate), ms (time), fL (volume), plus dimensionless state flags. Electrical supply/I/O ratings: V/VAC, Hz, W, µA and mA; TTL HIGH/LOW and direction/run/target flags are dimensionless. Scope: Legato 210 using the documented 200-series interface, not the 210P/270P analog option.
Source: Manuals/KDS Legato 200 Series_5617-002REV2.0.pdf, PDF pp. 6, 8, 11, 17–19, 62–65, 79, 89. Model scope: Legato 210 (788210).
